name: shooting-stars
title: Shooting Stars
description: A transparent overlay that launches a single glowing streak from a random screen edge every few seconds. Each one races diagonally across and fades off-frame.
use: A dark hero needs a sparse sense of motion and depth without distracting from the copy.
avoid: Streaks appear at random, so the effect can look empty for long stretches, and it never stops.
a11y: A purely decorative loop with no reduced-motion guard, and the streaks are invisible to assistive tech by design. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black field dusted with faint stars. Now and then a thin bright streak, white or tinted blue, cuts diagonally across the frame with a soft fading tail.
behaves: On a randomised delay a new streak starts at a random screen edge and races across at a random speed, growing slightly as it goes before vanishing off-frame. Nothing responds to the pointer.
customise: Tune minSpeed, maxSpeed, minDelay, maxDelay, star width and height, and the two gradient colours. Screen-edge starts and the growth rate are fixed.
weight: light: One SVG rect moved with requestAnimationFrame, plus a timer for the next star.
